column1: # Shared grammar table for the D16 settings keys (D16b, docs/handover/d16-settings-audit.md 3.4/3.6).
# Read by api/tests/test_d16b_core_grammar.py (Python twins in api/vault_api/core_settings.py and
# config.py) and, from D16c on, by the core shell tests against the hooks 26/27/28/40/45.
# Columns (TAB-separated): key, raw value, verdict, normalised value.
#   raw: the literal value, spaces kept; <blank> = the empty string.
#   verdict: ok | refused | unset (empty or whitespace the hook treats as "not set").
#   normalised: what the parser yields for ok ("-" otherwise): rate in bytes/s (off = 0),
#   window HH:MM-HH:MM or off, edge host or off, pool hosts single-space joined or off.
# off is exact and lowercase, after each parser's own whitespace handling: 27 strips nothing
# for the rate (" off " refused) but strips the window; 28 word-splits edge and pool hosts.
# A value-drift fix goes into this table; a grammar change goes into the hook AND its twin.
